title: CTGAN Credit-Risk: Synthetic Data for Model Validation
summary: A single-script pipeline for training a CTGAN synthesizer on credit-risk tabular data, then evaluating fidelity, TSTR utility, augmentation, and privacy. It imports CTGANSynthesizer and SingleTableMetadata from SDV, calling CTGANSynthesizer directly to generate the synthetic credit data used throughout the pipeline.
